{{Quote|One in a million Twi'leks have red skin. That makes me... rare. Exotic. Sought after.|Lethan Twi'lek [[Sarin (rebel agent)|Sarin's]] thoughts|<ref name="Rebel Heist 2">[[Rebel Heist 2|''Rebel Heist'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Lethan Twi'leks''' were [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] who had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin. Although it was said that only one in a million Twi'lek had red skin,<ref name="Rebel Heist 2" /> there were many [[Gender/Legends|female]] Lethan Twi'leks on [[Naos III/Legends|Naos III]].

[[Taunt]], [[Shakka/Legends|Shakka]], [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], [[Kelad'den]], [[Fa'ale Leh]], [[Zhar Lestin]], [[Yadira Ban]], [[B'ink Utrila]], [[Darth Atroxa]] and [[Darth Talon]] were Lethan Twi'leks. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] also had one who acted as his consort and [[Orn Free Taa's Twi'lek aide|aide]]. B'ink Utrila, Yadira Ban and Zhar Lestin were all examples of Lethan [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], while Darth Talon and Darth Atroxa are examples of a Lethan [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
